description: This file defines a class for validating arbitrary text according to the HTML specification within the HTMLPurifier library. It extends a base attribute definition class and provides a validate method that processes the input string as CDATA.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Text
classes.description: A class responsible for validating arbitrary text in HTML attributes according to the HTML spec within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input string as CDATA and returns the parsed content.
